executionModel.commitOwner: The orchestrator commits after the run with the AGENTS.md 1-6 section message and no Co-Authored-By or tool attribution line. Workers never run git mv, add, commit, stash, checkout, reset, branch, push or merge. A move is copy, then edit, then delete; git rename detection keeps history.
executionModel.concurrencyRule: Plans running in the same wave never share a non-artifact path. Each wave pairs at most one synth plan with one fx plan. The synth plan owns music-things/crates/music-things-synth/src/lib.rs and src/dsp/ugen/mod.rs; the fx plan owns music-things/crates/music-things-fx/src/lib.rs and src/dsp/effects/mod.rs. Disjoint paths do NOT mean independent builds: music-things-fx depends on music-things-synth, vactr depends on both, and vactr has one shared test crate. A mid-move synth plan therefore breaks every fx and vactr cargo command, and a mid-move fx plan breaks every vactr command. To limit this, every move plan follows the one-module-at-a-time order in protocol section 2.1 (copy, rewrite in the destination, crate pub mod, vactr pub use or shim, delete the source, then cargo check -p <own crate> and -p vactr), and the edit phase ends with an EDITS-COMPLETE <timestamp> line in the plan's own Progress Log (protocol section 5.1).
executionModel.retryPolicy: Protocol section 5.1. A failing gate or check command whose every error location or V-grep match lies in the concurrent sibling's writePaths or sharedPaths (this includes cargo check/clippy, V-nextest, V-names, V-grep, wasm builds, examples and vitest) is recorded as BLOCKED-BY-SIBLING <file:line> <command> and retried about every 60 s. The plan keeps waiting while the sibling's Progress Log lacks EDITS-COMPLETE, or while any sibling-owned file's sha256 changed within the last 15 minutes. A blocker is recorded only if the sibling shows EDITS-COMPLETE, its files have been unchanged for at least 15 minutes and the error persists, or if the plan's total wait reaches the overall cap of 120 minutes, which is below the node timeout. Cargo lock waits are retried under the same 120-minute cap. A sibling-located failure is never a pass: every blocked command is rerun, and the final verification records need exitStatus 0 on the combined tree. Failures with any error location in the plan's own paths are the plan's to fix.
executionModel.editProtocol: Before each edit, re-read the file and record its sha256 and intent in the plan's Progress Log. If someone else changed it, stop and record DRIFT. Record the post-edit sha256. Never edit outside writePaths and sharedPaths.
executionModel.serialReconciliation: Workers do not do workspace-wide formatting, Cargo.lock regeneration (MTX-00 only), plan archiving or impl-plans/README.md updates. A defect found in another plan's files is recorded as a blocker and repaired serially by the review step, with file, cause, fix and pre/post sha256. Never edit test expectations, goldens or tolerances.

designDecisionsAndRationale: The KernelContext/FxContext generic seam keeps 61+17 vactr test files unedited (design 4.1).

Fn-pointer shims with exact &Kx<'_> signatures cover 27 entry points that kernel_pairs.rs, digital_drum.rs, digital_metal.rs and plaits_drums_reference.rs use as higher-ranked fn pointers (design 4.1, added in Step 4).
EffectKind mirror with an exhaustive From conversion and the fx_kind_map test (design 4.2).
ported/* and ramp.rs stay in vactr (design 1.3).
nonGoals: Rewriting vactr design-section references in crate comments (MTQ2).
A crate-side FxUnit or smoothing wrapper.
intentionalTradeoffs: Kernel and effect-group entry points are generic over KernelContext/FxContext instead of taking a concrete crate context, so the 61 Kx and 17 FxCtx struct-literal test files stay unedited, at a small monomorphization compile-time cost (design 4.1, 11).
27 synth entry points keep vactr-side forwarding wrappers with exact &Kx<'_> signatures because generic fns cannot coerce to higher-ranked fn pointers (design 4.1).
The crate EffectKind/AnalyzerKind mirror vactr's enums one-to-one through an exhaustive hand-written From, with StreamVactr -> StreamOpto as the only rename (design 4.2).
src/dsp/ported/* and src/dsp/ramp.rs stay in vactr even though the intake listed them as movable: they are coverage inventories and engine-typed helpers (design 1.3).

Vactr-named identifiers are renamed inside the crates (vactrol_gate -> lpg, VactrolEnvelope -> OptoEnvelope, VACTROL* -> OPTO*), and vactr keeps alias shims so examples compile unchanged (design 4.3, 4.4).
vactr design-section references may stay in crate comments (MTQ2), and generic typed setters are used instead of per-kernel named setters (MTQ3).

One test, quad_mixer supports_rates_and_arbitrary_block_sizes_without_allocations, moves into vactr's src/dsp/tests/dsp/quad_mixer_alloc.rs because it needs vactr's test-only alloc_probe (design 6.3).

Same-branch synth and fx plans run concurrently in each wave; the one-module-at-a-time move order, EDITS-COMPLETE markers and BLOCKED-BY-SIBLING retry (protocol 2.1, 5.1) are what keep the shared vactr test crate compiling.
supportedEdgeCases: A call site passing &mut Kx where the generic context does not infer: pre-authorized &*kx rewrite in src/dsp/ugen/mixer.rs and src/dsp/voice.rs only (design 4.1).
Resource resolution for sample, wavetable and granular ugens keeps today's order: GranSrc::Bus -> zeros, missing resource -> zeros, before Ctl::read (design 4.3).
A vactr EffectKind variant added without a crate counterpart fails to compile through the exhaustive From, and fx_kind_map checks every graph::EffectKind::ALL name (design 4.2).
Tests moved between test binaries are matched by their <module>::tests::<name> suffix against the MTX-00 baseline list; none may be dropped (design 6.2).
A transient compile failure caused only by the concurrent sibling plan is recorded BLOCKED-BY-SIBLING and rerun, never counted as a pass (protocol 5.1).
The staged crates build as a standalone virtual workspace copy under tmp/music-things/MTX-91/standalone, which proves the drop-in layout (design 9.1, gate 10).
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Copying music-things/crates/* into the tacogips/music-things repository and switching vactr to a pinned git dependency (an operator follow-up).
Creating or editing music-things/crates/music-things (the facade crate) and the reserved names music-things-airwindows, music-things-soundfont and music-things-pitch.
Rewriting historical design docs that name old src/dsp paths (design 11).
Adding --workspace to mise run test/clippy tasks (MTQ1).
Any change to language semantics, editor UI, session protocol, scheduler, pattern code, catalogs, codec or the ported coverage manifest table.
Changes to f32 results through reordered arithmetic, mul_add, changed literal types, or changed defaults, ranges, port order, *_STATE_FLOATS or mem_len values (design 5).
residualRisks: The From mapping over 130 variants is written by hand; fx_kind_map and the goldens guard it.
Concurrent cargo builds in the same directory may fail transiently on a sibling's edits; the BLOCKED-BY-SIBLING retry handles this.
The sibling-wait duration depends on implementer pace. It is bounded by the 120-minute cap, which is below the node timeout.
The &mut Kx -> &C reborrow and the nextest oneline format are not compiled or run yet. The &*kx fallback and the first-space split are pre-authorized.
